-- Counts the names whose file inside `notes` reads as non-empty text.
-- A missing or unreadable file reads as "", so it is not counted.
-- Names are untrusted: all reads go through fs confined to `notes`,
-- so a name that tries to leave `notes` cannot reach any outside file.
count_readable(names: List[str]) -> int uses fs =
  post out >= 0
  post out <= names.len()
  ex count_readable([]) == 0
  var n = 0
  with fs = fs.sub("notes")
    for name in names
      let text = fs.read(name) else ""
      if text.char_count() > 0
        n += 1
  n
